This looks like a corn cob cross-section, a single round piece about 100 mm across. The plate is roughly 26 cm wide, which works out to about 575 px, or about 0.45 mm per px. The corn spans about 105 px, so about 4.7 cm across. It is probably about 2.5 cm thick, which gives a volume of roughly 43 cm³. The cob core takes up some of that, so I estimate about 40 g. Corn on the cob is about 90 kcal/100 g. The few loose kernels add only a gram or two.
